Name: Front-view Abigail
Author: lolmariam
Description:
I love the original 16-bit style that Stardew Valley has for their portraits.

However, I feel like some of the NPCs portraits didn't look appropriate: for Abigail, I don't like how her portrait was not front-viewing like many of the other portraits.

In my portrait mod, I based off of the portrait that CA created (including earlier versions) but modified it to give her a youthful appearance, nicer hair, making her bow visible, and giving her a choker. This, in turn, makes her look [i]SO CUTE.[/i]

I hope you like it. I'm not an expert and this is my first time doing it, but this is how I wanted her to look in my game! :)

If there's any issues with it, please let me know. I tested it out in my game and it seemed to work fine.




[u]To use this mod, you need to install the following mods: [/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK - Patonymous Toolkit[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]



[u]Here's how to install the portrait mod:[/u]

﻿Put the .png images inside the Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\lolmariam folder on your computer. [i]This is where you keep your portrait mods created by me. (When you download Portraiture, it will create a folder. In that folder, there is a Portraits folder. For each different group of portraits that you want to toggle from, create a named folder to separate them.)

[/i]To switch the portraits and reveal the modded version, press P in-game during a dialogue with said NPC. [i]It should keep that portrait throughout the game until changed again.
[/i]

If there are any issues with the portrait mod (including alignment or quality), please contact me.

[i]This mod has only been uploaded to NexusMods.com.

[/i]
